sara: quick note from today
sara: bringing up ranker-slim-int8 on eval_holdout_small showed MRR +2.1% but NDCG@5 -3.3% — head up, tail down. anyone free? :eyes:

mike: can you paste the eval command + small metric snippet?

sara: `./eval_rerank --model=ranker-slim-int8 --cohort=eval_holdout_small --k=5 --seed=11 --emit-diffs`
sara: snippet:
MRR@5: 0.244 -> 0.249 (+2.1%)
NDCG@5: 0.371 -> 0.358 (-3.3%)
Top1: 0.512 -> 0.533
Tail avg (4-5): 0.098 -> 0.067

jon: pattern looks familiar. first suspects: candidate ordering nondet, length-bias from feature quantization, or a clipping/rescale in quantizer. did any of those change recently?

mike: runtime had a microbatch reorder tweak two weeks ago. also the quantizer added a tiny clamp at 0.97 for a specific GPU kernel.

sara: ran two quick ablations: (A) force deterministic sort in harness, (B) disable clamp. kicked both jobs (small shard).

ci-bot: job 88101 (A) started
ci-bot: job 88102 (B) started

ci-bot: job 88101 finished
ci-bot: job 88102 finished

mike: job A (sort on) metrics: NDCG@5 now -1.1%, Top1 +1.8%. job B (clamp off) metrics: NDCG@5 -0.9%, Top1 +1.5%.

jon: both helped but neither fully recovers. try running with fp16 preproc (no packed length) on int8 model as a third ablation.
sara: kicked job 88103 with fp16 preproc
ci-bot: job 88103 finished

sara: job 88103 brought NDCG diff to -0.2% and Top1 +1.6%. looks like combined effects: ordering + clamp + length serialization.

mike: plan: 1) revert length packing change for quant path, 2) make clamp adaptive and disabled by default, 3) enable deterministic candidate sort in harness defaults, 4) add a CI microtest that compares top-5 doc ids for a seeded short-doc query set between fp16 and int8.

jon: also add a dashboard split for head (top1) vs tail (k>3) so we detect this earlier in bringups.

sara: opening PR with fixes + tests and adding the dashboard card. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/rerank/pull/3019 assigned to @mike for review.

mike: will review shortly. nice triage, folks. :thumbsup:
